name: Derrell Hines

Hines plants hard on 12-15 yard comebacks and creates instant separation with decisive breaks.
Hines high-points fades over the outside shoulder in the red zone and plucks the ball away from his frame.
Hines turns short catches north-south quickly -- slant/YAC juice after the catch on a lean 6-1 frame.
weaknesses: Hines still needs functional weight on the 6-1 / 170 frame to hold up versus physical press and SEC contact balance.

projection: Hines projects as develop into the WR room, earn early perimeter package snaps as a vertical/intermediate separator, then compete for a starting X/Z role -- starter upside as a lean boundary threat who wins with stems and ball skills.
